note: Village of Ewing campground on the Cowboy Trail, 1/4 mi north of US 275 at NE 45B. Six or seven angled gravel pads with electric and water (sewer reported too), no shade; restrooms and a shelter are at the ball field next door. Pay at City Hall or the drop box. Open year-round. --Claude  CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $13 a night in June 2024 (Campendium review) and September 2024 (Cowboy Trail forum); the village has no web page (2026-11-05). Call the village office, 402-626-7718. --Claude
